bullets.text: NPU Enhances Windows Intelligence - **Microsoft**'s new NPU chips boost AI tasks on Copilot+ PCs, enhancing user experiences.
Microsoft Leads in Cybersecurity - **Microsoft Defender XDR** recognized as a leader in the IDC MarketScape for its comprehensive security solutions.
Celebrating 50 Years with Crocs - **Microsoft** launches limited edition Crocs inspired by Windows XP for its anniversary.
Microsoft 365 Premium Unveiled - New subscription combines AI and productivity tools for individuals at an unbeatable price.
Cybersecurity Awareness Month Kicks Off - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of online safety and security habits for everyone.
Windows 11 Update Available - The **Windows 11 2025 Update** introduces security enhancements and streamlined features.
TypeScript 7 Native Preview Released - **Visual Studio 2026** now supports TypeScript 7, improving compile times significantly.
Introducing Agent Mode in Copilot - **Microsoft 365 Copilot** now features Agent Mode for enhanced productivity in Office apps.
